summary: ING Groep N.V. furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) with an Exhibit 99.1 press release updating progress on its EUR 1.0 billion share buyback programme announced 30 April 2026. During 7-11 September 2026, ING repurchased 1,380,000 shares at an average price of EUR 31.82 for EUR 43,905,995. Programme-to-date: 26,310,805 shares at an average EUR 27.97 for EUR 735,916,667.99, about 73.59% of maximum value. Shares are cancelled to reduce share capital. Watch execution pace versus the remaining tranche and any earnings-related suspension risk.
